# xterm.js v5.5.0 and addon-fit v0.10.0

Copies of `lib/xterm.js` and `css/xterm.css` from
[@xterm/xterm](https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js) v5.5.0, and
`lib/addon-fit.js` from @xterm/addon-fit v0.10.0 (MIT, see LICENSE), without
their source map lines: the terminal of a hi team's dev page. hi embeds them
and serves them with the page (team_devpage.go), so the page loads nothing
from elsewhere.
